Metadata.title: Willian Justen | Product engineer
Metadata.description: Product engineer at Spoke. I take products from the fuzzy problem to the shipped thing, and spend the rest of my time behind a camera, a controller, or a boarding pass.
Metadata.tagline: Product engineer. Photos, games, the NBA and trips.

FarewellBanner.label: Blog retirement notice
FarewellBanner.message: Thank you for following the blog all these years. It is retired now, and this site is my home for places, games, NBA and music.

Hero.name: Willian Justen
Hero.lead: Product engineer at Spoke. I take products from the fuzzy problem to the shipped thing, and spend the rest of my time behind a camera, a controller, or a boarding pass.

places.title: Where the camera's been.
places.intro: Every pin is a place I've been, holding the photos I brought back. Most of them also live on Unsplash and Pexels, free to use.

globe.description: A 3D dotted globe you can spin, with photo pins on the places I've been. Use the arrow keys to rotate it.
globe.hint: drag to spin · open a pin

games.title: Press start.
games.intro: What I'm playing, what I've finished and what's next on the list. Got a game I should try? Tell me.

nba.title: Courtside.
nba.intro: I watch way too much basketball, so I built the NBA app I wanted to open every night: scores, standings and playoffs, without the noise.

game.title: Take a shot
game.hint: Drag the ball back, aim, let go.
game.onFireHint: You're on fire. Keep it going.
game.canvasDescription: Basketball mini game: drag the ball back and let go to shoot at the hoop. With the keyboard, hold Space to build power, use the up and down arrows to change the angle, and let go to shoot.
game.firstTimeHint: ← drag the ball back, let go to shoot
game.keyboardAim: angle {angle}°  ·  ↑↓ to aim, let go of Space to shoot

music.title: Every post ended with a song.
music.intro: The posts are gone. The songs stay. Here's what's on repeat right now, and what came before it.
music.record: Spinning record. Drag it to scratch.
music.hint: tilt it · drag the record to scratch

Footer.headline: Say <accent>hi.</accent>
